key_derivation: `git grep -l "Auto-generated by"` over the tracked tree returns exactly 10 paths and nothing else: the 5 generators (each writes that banner into its own output) and the 5 outputs. The set is therefore closed - the banner string cannot appear in a generated file without the generator that wrote it. Direction is read off each generator's two module-level path variables: options_js.py:14-16, backend_consts.py:10-12, tflow_js.py:13-15 and state_js.py:14-16 all have `filename` under web/src/, whereas web_columns.py:10-11 has `input_filename` under web/src/ and `filename` at ../../mitmproxy/tools/w
